    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于Hutool的poi导出excel表格【升级更新】</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>今天记录一下基于Hutool的poi导出excel表格，这次代码是升级更新版本的代码。推荐各位收藏</p>
<p>1.先看导出excel模版截图</p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1042681/202605/1042681-20260508151703271-982221378.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.准备环境</p>
<p>我贴出整个的pom文件，如果不需要的，可以根据自己要求进行删减</p>

<p>3.完整的测试代码</p>
<pre class="language-java highlighter-hljs"><code>package com.yinhai;


import cn.hutool.poi.excel.ExcelUtil;
import cn.hutool.poi.excel.ExcelWriter;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

@SpringBootTest
public class AppTest
{
    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    // 阶段1
    @Test
    public void test() throws IOException {

        // 1. 强制使用兼容的XML处理器
        System.setProperty("javax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory",
                "com.sun.org.apache.xalan.internal.xsltc.trax.TransformerFactoryImpl");
       
        String sql = "SELECT \n" +
                "    b.bjmc,\n" +
                "    c.ygxm,\n" +
                "    MAX(CASE WHEN d.homework_id = 8 THEN d.homework_score END) AS \"ES6\",\n" +
                "    MAX(CASE WHEN d.homework_id = 10 THEN d.homework_score END) AS \"VUE\",\n" +
                "\t\tMAX(CASE WHEN d.homework_id = 14 THEN d.homework_score END) AS \"Form\",\n" +
                "\t\tMAX(CASE WHEN d.homework_id = 17 THEN d.homework_score END) AS \"Bigtable\",\n" +
                "\t\tMAX(CASE WHEN e.exam_id = 2 THEN e.exam_score END) AS \"exam_1\",\n" +
                "\t\tMAX(CASE WHEN e.exam_id = 1 THEN e.exam_score END) AS \"exam_2\",\n" +
                "\t\tMAX(CASE WHEN f.proj_id = 5 THEN f.proj_score END) AS \"proj\",\n" +
                "\t\tMAX(CASE WHEN g.course_id = 1 THEN g.course_score END) AS \"summary\"\n" +
                "FROM \n" +
                "    yhykt_gp_trainee_class_relative a\n" +
                "    JOIN yhykt_gp_classes b ON a.bjbh = b.bjbh\n" +
                "    JOIN yhykt_gp_trainee c ON a.ygbh = c.ygbh\n" +
                "    JOIN yhykt_gp_trainee_homework d ON c.ygbh = d.ygbh AND b.bjbh = d.bjbh\n" +
                "\t\tJOIN yhykt_gp_trainee_exam e on c.ygbh = e.ygbh and b.bjbh = e.bjbh\n" +
                "\t\tJOIN yhykt_gp_trainee_project f on c.ygbh = f.ygbh and b.bjbh = f.bjbh\n" +
                "\t\tJOIN yhykt_gp_trainee_course_relative g on c.ygbh = g.ygbh and b.bjbh = g.bjbh\n" +
                "WHERE \n" +
                "    b.bjbh = '202306280000001'\n" +
                "    AND d.homework_id IN (8, 10, 14, 17)\n" +
                "\t\tand e.exam_id in (2,1)\n" +
                "\t\tand f.proj_id in (5)\n" +
                "\t\tand g.course_id in (1)\n" +
                "GROUP BY \n" +
                "    b.bjmc, c.ygxm, g.course_score\n" +
                "ORDER BY \n" +
                "    g.course_score desc, b.bjmc, c.ygxm;";

        // 使用 try-with-resources 自动关闭资源
        // 使用getBigWriter()创建支持大数据量的XLSX格式写入器
        try (ExcelWriter writer = ExcelUtil.getBigWriter();
             FileOutputStream outputStream = new FileOutputStream("D:/阶段1.xlsx")) {

            // 写入表头
            writer.writeRow(Arrays.asList("班级编号", "姓名", "ES6作业", "VUE作业", "Form作业", "table作业", "作业汇总", "前端笔试", "1阶段项目", "1阶段汇总"));

            // 查询数据
            List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; maps = jdbcTemplate.queryForList(sql);

            // 写入数据行
            for (Map&lt;String, Object&gt; map : maps) {
                BigDecimal exam_1 = (BigDecimal) map.get("exam_1");
                BigDecimal exam_2 = (BigDecimal) map.get("exam_2");
                BigDecimal es6 = (BigDecimal) map.get("ES6");
                BigDecimal vue = (BigDecimal) map.get("VUE");
                BigDecimal bigtable =(BigDecimal)map.get("Bigtable");
                writer.writeRow(Arrays.asList(
                        map.get("bjmc"),
                        map.get("ygxm"),
                        map.get("ES6"),
                        map.get("VUE"),
                        map.get("Form"),
                        map.get("Bigtable"),
                        es6.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.3")).add(vue.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.3"))).add(bigtable.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.4"))),
                        exam_1,
                        map.get("proj"),
                        map.get("summary")
                ));
            }

            // 刷新到文件
            writer.flush(outputStream, true);
        } // 自动关闭 writer 和 outputStream
    }


}</code></pre>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
